title: Sewer Scavenger's Riddle
subtitle: A Quest for the Cleverest Rat
description: Dive into the murky depths of the city’s underbelly, where treasures await those clever enough to solve the riddles of the Sewer Scavenger. Navigate through pipes, balance weights, and unlock secrets to claim your prize. Only the sharpest minds will emerge victorious from this dank labyrinth.
introduction:
Welcome, whiskered wanderer, to my damp domain beneath the cobblestones…
I have treasures hidden in fetid pools and rusty corners—yours if you dare.
Answer my riddle, and the finest scrap you’ve ever seen will be yours.
Fail, and you’ll leave smelling like last week’s sludge. Ready, rat?

Well met, furry filcher of filth! I’ve scavenged prizes from every clogged drain.
But I only part with my spoils for those clever enough to crack a sewer’s secret.
Solve my puzzle, and I’ll hand over a gleaming piece of undercity gold—no mold included.
Think you’re up to the task, four-legged tinkerer?

Oi, scuttle-paws, fancy a bit of rare loot from the bowels of this city?
I’ve got more shiny bits than a crow’s nest, but I don’t give ‘em away for free.
Prove your wit with my riddle—then I’ll slide you the goods through this manhole.
Fail, and you’ll be knee-deep in sewer slime till the next tide. Care to play?
Hello there! Let's see how smart you are. Ready for some questions?

Greetings, clever critter! I have some puzzles for you. Solve them to earn your loot.

questions.question: Three pipes line these tunnels: Stream A flows slower than Stream B, but Stream B is not the swiftest. Stream C outpaces Stream A. Which pipe bears the fastest current?
options: All three flow at the same speed

questions.question: Before you lies an ancient balance and four scrap weights: a bolt (1), a coil of wire (3), a dented can (5) and a capped wire bundle (7). Which combination exactly sums to 10 so the hatch swings open?
A heptagonal relief sits on the wall with seven shaped holes—triangle, square, pentagon… up to heptagon. You hold seven fragments of matching shapes. How do you unlock the vault?
options: Rotate each fragment to match its hole and insert
Press the center of the heptagon three times
Turn the entire panel until it clicks

questions.question: I hide the city in darkness, yet contain no stone nor steel. I reek, I teem, I rumble—home to squeakers and your kind. What am I?
I have no lungs, yet I breathe through these tunnels. I have no lips, yet I speak your name back at you. What am I?
I'm born of hair, grime and time; I lurk in pipes and make them choke. You tug and pull, but still I grow. What foul thing am I?
I twist and turn through walls and floors, carrying muck and secrets galore. You cannot see me, yet rely on my flow. What invisible artery am I?
I scurry without feet, squeak without lips, nibble without teeth. I haunt these tunnels yet fear the light. Who am I?
I swell in the rain and shrink in the sun; I coat your paws yet vanish when dry. I’m sticky, I’m slick—what am I?
I fall from the sky but drown in the depths. I can flood these halls but leave no trace at dawn. What am I?
